$comment: Machine requirements for knowledge-mcp. Single owner of the requirement table: the doctor (knowledge_status and --doctor) renders it, ../install.sh reads the same file with jq for `list`. Nothing here installs anything; each entry names the exact command and the package manager it needs, so the doctor can tell 'missing but installable here' from 'cannot be installed on this machine'. `check` is the binary looked up on PATH; `required` marks the ones the server cannot work without; the `setup` block tells install.sh that this server needs a one-time configuration step before it is useful.

binaries.note: lexical floor of every search path
BM25 index; without it search degrades to ripgrep, then run qmd collection add <vault> && qmd update

binaries.install: install git with your package manager

setup.reason: a vault configuration is required: name the directories that hold your notes
